ModMetaData.name: Sleep Schedule
ModMetaData.author: Steven
ModMetaData.description:
Save named 24-hour schedules and apply them to colonists in one click.
What it does - Paint a 24-hour schedule (Anything, Work, Recreation, Sleep, Meditate) and save it as a preset. - Apply a preset to one or many colonists from the Schedule tab or the colonist gizmo. - Copy a colonist's current schedule into a new preset. - Set a preset as the default for new colonists. - Starter presets included: Vanilla Day, Day Worker, Night Owl, Night Shift, Biphasic, Child, Psycaster.
How to use - Open the Schedule tab and click Presets, or select colonists and use the Schedule preset gizmo. - Make or edit presets in the manager. Hours are painted by clicking or dragging. - Mod settings: open the manager from the Mod Settings page.
Two places to keep presets - My library: your personal presets. They live in mod settings and follow you across every save file. - This colony: stored inside the save. Shared by everyone playing that colony.
Multiplayer Supported. Each player has their own My library. Colony presets, applying a preset and the new-pawn default are synced. Load this mod after Multiplayer.
Requirements - Harmony (required). - Royalty is optional. Meditate hours only appear with Royalty.
Safe to add to an existing save. Removing it leaves schedules as they are.
